pages.text: You have created a massive mobile pile of bones. Despite its rather unsettling appearance, these hulking creatures are absolutely loyal to you.
You can customize your Rambler's appearance with different Rambler skulls—a necromancer's favorite feature.
As an undead servant, wearing Necro Robes passively regenerates your Rambler's health. You can also manually heal them by right-clicking with Bone Meal, Bones, or Bone Blocks.

To customize your Rambler's skull appearance, right-click it with the skull you wish to apply. Right-click with an empty hand cycles through the available slots. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand removes the skull from the current slot.
